english: Let $a_1,a_2,\dots,a_{40}$ be the arithmetic progression with $a_1=20$ and common difference $-3$, and let $b_1,b_2,\dots,b_{40}$ be the arithmetic progression with $b_1=-50$ and common difference $4$. Then the sum of those terms of the first progression that are not terms of the second progression is ______.
hindi: माना $a_1,a_2,\dots,a_{40}$ वह समान्तर श्रेढ़ी है जिसमें $a_1=20$ तथा सार्व अन्तर $-3$ है, तथा $b_1,b_2,\dots,b_{40}$ वह समान्तर श्रेढ़ी है जिसमें $b_1=-50$ तथा सार्व अन्तर $4$ है। तब प्रथम श्रेढ़ी के उन पदों का योग, जो द्वितीय श्रेढ़ी के पद नहीं हैं, ______ है।
solution: $a_k\equiv2\pmod 3$ and $b_k\equiv2\pmod 4$, so a common term is $\equiv2\pmod{12}$
solution_full: The first progression is $20,17,14,\dots$ with $a_{40}=20+39(-3)=-97$; its sum is $\dfrac{40}{2}(20+(-97))=-1540$.

Every $a_k=20-3(k-1)$ leaves remainder $2$ on division by $3$, and every $b_k=-50+4(k-1)$ leaves remainder $2$ on division by $4$. A number common to both is therefore $\equiv2\pmod 3$ and $\equiv2\pmod 4$, that is, $\equiv2\pmod{12}$.

Conversely, a number $\equiv2\pmod{12}$ is a term of the first progression if it lies in $[-97,20]$ and a term of the second if it lies in $[-50,106]$. So the common terms are the numbers $\equiv2\pmod{12}$ in $[-50,20]$.
These are $-46,-34,-22,-10,2,14$: an arithmetic progression of $6$ terms with common difference $12$ (the l.c.m. of $3$ and $4$). Their sum is $\dfrac62(-46+14)=-96$.
The terms of the first progression that are not terms of the second therefore sum to $-1540-(-96)=-1444$.
originality_note: New: a decreasing and an increasing finite AP whose overlap window is cut off at one end by each progression; the asked quantity is the complement sum (way 5: common terms combined with the sum of an AP). Closest known: 'number / sum of common terms of 3, 7, 11, ..., 407 and 2, 9, 16, ..., 709'. Different because: the progressions run in opposite directions, so the window [-50, 20] comes from different ends, and the complement must be taken.

concept_use.Common terms of 2 or more Aps: Common terms are the numbers = 2 (mod 12) inside the overlap window [-50, 20]; they form an AP with difference lcm(3, 4) = 12.
